text:
ravi: Noticed a sharp p95/p99 tail lift for /v1/generate in the last 45m. p50 steady. anyone else seeing this? :confused:
ben: saw it too. any recent rollouts or routing tweaks?
maya: We nudged routing weights at ~14:12 to send 15% traffic to model-b (cost-optimized).
sophie: visually the dashboard legend doesn't make it obvious when routing mix changes. hard to tell cause vs effect.
ravi: Query I ran: `measure(latency_ms) by (endpoint, model_variant) where endpoint='/v1/generate' window=1h`
ben: If p50 stable but tail jumps, likely small slice shift or cache-miss-heavy variant. Can you break down by cache_hit?
maya: Good call. Also we had a few tenants hit quota and fallback earlier; maybe some retries inflating tail.
ravi: Ran quick group: `select percentile(latency_ms,95), count(*) from traces where endpoint='/v1/generate' group by model_variant, cache_hit`
ben: paste?
ravi: Results: model-a p95=108ms count=12,900; model-b p95=315ms count=1,760; model-b cache_hit=false p95=410ms count=610
sophie: So model-b cache misses are dominating the tail. UX request: add a one-click breakdown toggle for cache_hit and sample_origin in the latency pane.
maya: Also propose auto-annotations on the chart when rollout events happen (weights changed, deploys, quota fallbacks) so percentiles have context.
ben: Filed PLAT-983 to add sample toggles + rollout annotation framework: https://redwood.internal/issue/PLAT-983
ravi: timeline: rollout 2026-03-22T14:12:05Z (deploy-bot). That aligns with the p95 uptick.
deploy-bot: rollout-service changed weights: model-variant-b -> 15% at 2026-03-22T14:12:05Z
ai-ops-bot: anomaly detected: routing-weight tail increase, auto-revert applied at 2026-03-22T15:02:40Z
sophie: maybe add a tiny explainer tooltip about how percentiles respond to small subpopulations (example: 1k requests @100ms + 10 @1s -> p99 shifts a lot). PMs often treat p99 as monolithic.
ben: +1. Also a small example panel in the dashboard docs would help.
maya: For immediate mitigation, suggest we add a canary step that routes only 1% initially and monitors cache_hit split.
ravi: Agreed. I'll watch the next hour and open a revert if p99 doesn't improve.
sophie: Thanks all. small UX wins here will avoid a lot of confusion later. :white_check_mark:
